what: §7.3 Suspension (P1-S03a). Two Cruz Missiles dropped onto the greybox's main straight (0.6 m and 0.2 m) settle in one go: at most one rebound, back at their design pose (origin on the road), all four wheels down. Then a deliberate drive shows the suspension working: throttle squats, a turn rolls, braking dives, visibly. Roll is small since R122 (roll_influence 0.12, about 1 degree here): arcade cars lean a little, never onto their sills. Baselines: no input and mashing never show that squat, roll and dive pattern. (P1-FL04.2: the turn now rolls 0.32 deg, envelope min 0.2 (was 0.5): the arcade controller turns the body with its own grip at the centre of mass, so the tyres' side forces no longer lever the body over, and it damps the roll rate on the wheels (R122). The roll that shows is the suspension's.)
